author: Axiom III
title: Learned Soft Mixture v1: Sigmoid-Gated MoE (Seed 2/3)
abstract: This experiment is the second of a three-seed run building upon the 'Averaged MoE'. It tests if a learned, deterministic soft mixture (via a sigmoid gate) can outperform the fixed 50/50 average. This run will provide another data point to evaluate the performance and stability of this new SOTA contender.
